speaker: god
text: I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks. Then you will not walk so proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day they will take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation: ‘We are utterly ruined! He has changed the portion of my people. How He has removed it from me! He has allotted our fields to traitors.’
name: The LORD

speaker: false-prophets
text: Do not preach,
name: The false prophets

speaker: false-prophets
text: Do not preach these things; disgrace will not overtake us.
name: The false prophets

speaker: israelites
text: Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these the things He does?
name: Israel

speaker: micah
text: Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?
name: Micah

speaker: micah
text: You hate good and love evil. You tear the skin from my people and strip the flesh from their bones.
name: Micah

speaker: micah
text: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.
name: Micah

speaker: god
text: As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore night will come over you without visions, and darkness without divination. The sun will set on these prophets, and the daylight will turn black over them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.
name: Israel

speaker: nations
text: Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.
name: The nations

speaker: god
text: On that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will make the lame into a remnant, and the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: nations
text: Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.
name: The nations

speaker: god
text: In that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I am striking you severely, to ruin you because of your sins.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will eat but not be satisfied, and your hunger will remain with you. What you acquire, you will not preserve; and what you save, I will give to the sword.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their counsel. Therefore I will make you a desolation, and your inhabitants an object of contempt; you will bear the scorn of the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: enemy
text: Where is the LORD your God?
name: My enemy
